name: Kanagawa

flag.description: A red kanji 神 (kana) drawn symmetrically on a white field.
flag.symbolism: 神 is the first character of Kanagawa.

hook: Kanagawa's red emblem on white is the kanji 神 (kana), the first character of its name, drawn as a mirror-image pattern of lines.
trivia: Yokohama, the capital, is Japan's second-largest city.
Kamakura was the seat of Japan's first shogunate, from 1185 to 1333.
